items.t: 엔비디아, 다음달 27일 네이버 3대 주주 오른다
items.fullText: 핫스톡 주목 이 종목! 엔비디아, 다음달 27일 네이버 3대 주주 오른다 입력 2026.10.30 07:49 수정 2026.10.30 07:52 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 정지은 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. AI 기사요약 네이버가 엔비디아를 대상으로 10억 달러 규모의 제3자 배정 유상증자를 단행해 엔비디아를 3대 주주로 맞이하며, 글로벌 AI 팩토리 구축과 기술 협력을 통한 글로벌 AI 시장 공략을 본격화한다. 네이버, 엔비디아 유증 실시 공시 이해진 지분율 4.03%→3.84% 글로벌 AI 팩토리 사업 본격화 엔비디아 가 다음달 27일 네이버 의 3대 주주에 오른다. 네이버와 엔비디아, 대체자산운용사 브룩필드 가 손잡고 추진하는 ‘글로벌 인공지능(AI) 팩토리’ 구축 사업이 본격화한다. 네이버는 엔비디아를 대상으로 10억달러 규모의 제3자 배정 유상증자를 실시한다고 30일 공시했다. 다음달 3일 최종 발행 주식 수를 확정하고 6일 납입을 완료할 예정이다. 신주 상장 예정일은 다음달 27일이다. 한경 프리미엄9의 모든 콘텐츠는 한국경제신문의 저작물로 저작권법의 보호를 받습니다. 사전 허가 없는 무단 전재·복제·배포·캡처 공유·AI 학습 활용 및 상업적 이용을 금합니다. 위반 시 서비스 이용 제한 및 민형사상 법적 책임이 발생할 수 있습니다. 무료 열람 혜택으로 기사를 읽으셨습니다. 한경 프리미엄9을 구독하고 무제한으로 만나보세요. 구독하기 AI 뉴스 Q&A 더 궁금한 점이 있으신가요? 읽으면서 머릿속에 맴돌던 질문들, 앨리스가 대답해 드릴게요. 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 생성되었으며, 일부 내용에 오류가 있을 수 있습니다. AI 포인트 뷰 이전 분석 종목 다음 분석 종목 본 서비스의 AI가 제공하는 종목 정보는 정보 제공 목적의 참고 자료일 뿐, 투자 권유·자문·추천에 해당하지 않습니다. 투자에 따른 손실 책임은 사용자에게 있습니다. 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 정지은 기자 한국경제신문 테크&사이언스부에서 플랫폼, 게임, 과학기술, 스타트업 등을 담당하고 있습니다. 제보 메일 환영합니다. 기사댓글 개의 댓글이 있습니다. 댓글 닫기

items.fullText: 국제 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 "사진 찍고 친분 과시"…女 기업인 젠슨 황에 접근한 이유 입력 2026.10.30 06:46 수정 2026.10.30 07:29 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 강경주 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 美 정보당국 "엔비디아 정보수집 中스파이" 넷선더 링크드인 캡처 중국 스파이가 젠슨 황 엔비디아 최고경영자(CEO)에게 접근해 정보를 수집했다는 외신 보도가 나왔다. 미 정보당국은 중국 국적의 데이터센터 기업 임원이 황 CEO와 친분을 쌓고 엔비디아의 핵심 기술 및 미국 정부의 대중국 정책 관련 정보를 파악하려 한 것으로 의심하고 있다. 연합뉴스에 따르면 미 정보당국은 중국 국적을 지닌 '앨리스 황'이라는 인물이 황 CEO와 긴밀한 관계를 맺고 중국으로 정보를 유출해온 것으로 보고 있다고 뉴욕타임스(NYT)가 복수 소식통을 인용해 29일(현지시간) 보도했다. 앨리스 황은 싱가포르에 본사를 둔 데이터센터 기업 메가스피드의 고위 임원이다. 일부 중국 자료는 그가 과거 중국에서 방송기자로 일했던 것으로 소개하고 있으며, 이후 그는 중국의 주요 은행들에서 근무했고 이어 반도체와 AI 기업 등에 자금을 대는 투자사 허시캐피털에서도 일했다. 그는 외부에서 자신이 메가스피드의 CEO라고 소개했지만, 회사 자료를 보면 실제로는 설립 초기 경영이사(managing director)를 지냈고 이후 이사직에서도 물러난 것으로 확인된다. 메가스피드는 싱가포르에 본사를 둔 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 기업으로, 엔비디아의 고성능 AI 반도체를 구매해 데이터센터를 구축하는 회사다. 자체 데이터센터의 연산 자원을 중국 등 AI 기업에 빌려주고 사용료를 받는 클라우드 컴퓨팅 사업을 한다. 미국은 이 회사가 엔비디아의 대중 수출 규제를 우회해 첨단 반도체를 중국에 빼돌렸을 가능성을 의심해 2024년부터 조사하고 있다. 미 당국은 앨리스 황에 대해 전자 감시를 진행하던 중, 그가 한 미국 시민과 접촉하고 있다는 사실을 확인했다. 곧이어 대상이 누구인지 확인하는 '신원 공개'(unmasking) 절차를 통해 해당 미국 시민이 황CEO라는 사실이 드러났다. 앨리스 황은 2024년 6월 대만 타이베이의 한 바에서 다른 AI 기업 임원들이 동석한 자리에서 황 CEO의 옆자리에 앉아 함께 술을 마시는 모습이 사회관계망서비스(SNS) 링크트인 사진으로 확인됐다. 또 지난해 5월에도 다른 AI 공급업체 관계자들과 함께 황 CEO와 업무 만찬을 마친 뒤 식당을 나서는 모습이 포착됐다. 자신의 SNS에 황 CEO와 찍은 사진을 올리며 친분을 과시해 투자금을 모으기도 한 것으로 전해졌다. 백악관에는 비상이 걸렸다. 앨리스 황이 황 CEO를 통해 엔비디아 기술 관련 정보는 물론이고 미중 관계에 대한 트럼프 대통령의 시각 등을 파악했을 가능성이 있기 때문이다. 이 문제는 다음 달 트럼프 대통령의 중국 방문 때도 논의 의제가 될 가능성이 크다고 NYT는 짚었다. 그러나 트럼프 대통령은 약 1년 전 이와 같은 보고를 받고도 별도의 조치를 취하지 않았다고 보도했다. 이와 관련해 엔비디아는 황 CEO와 앨리스 황은 통상의 업무 관계라고 해명했다. 존 리조 엔비디아 대변인은 "고객과의 만남은 CEO 업무의 일부이며 황 CEO는 매년 수천 명의 고객사 임원과 대화를 나눈다"며 "만약 특정 인물이 미국 산업에 위협이 된다고 미국 정부가 판단했다면 우리에게 알렸을 것이라고 확신한다"고 말했다. 주미 중국대사관의 류창 대변인은 이에 대해 "근거 없는 모함과 비방"이라고 일축했다. 메가스피드 측은 "이 문제를 극도로 심각하게 받아들이고 있으며 관련 사실관계를 규명하기 위해 최선을 다하고 있다"며 미국 정부 조사에 적극 협조하고 있다는 입장을

US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO
items.d: A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud company that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, sources have told the New York Times.
items.fullText: In Brief Posted: 9:42 AM PDT · October 29, 2026 Image Credits: Nvidia Julie Bort US investigated Chinese spy plot aimed at Nvidia CEO A top executive of a Singapore AI cloud firm that was accused of illegally selling Nvidia chips to China could also have been a Chinese spy, anonymous sources told the New York Times . The executive, Alice Huang (or Huang Le), worked for Megaspeed and was photographed as one of multiple people hanging out with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang during various business dinners in the Singapore region. U.S. intelligence agencies had been surveilling Alice Huang to learn more about her ties with China for about a year, the Times reports. The concern, sources said, was that Alice Huang had grown so close to Jensen Huang that she could have been gathering information about Nvidia’s plans and the CEO’s efforts to convince the Trump administration to allow it to ship more advanced technology to China. But an Nvidia spokesperson denied this, telling TechCrunch that the CEO’s relationship with the Megaspeed executive was the same as with any other regional customer. “Jensen’s interactions with Ms. Huang are not unusual or unexpected. Meetings with customers are part of a C.E.O.’s job; Jensen talks with thousands of customer executives every year,” the spokesperson said in an emailed statement. The company also said, “Our regional cloud customers receive ordinary business information — not sensitive NVIDIA trade secrets — and zero information relevant to national security.” In 2025, the Times reported that the Commerce Department had investigated Megaspeed over concerns that it was helping Chinese companies sidestep AI chip export regulations by reselling restricted chips to them. Alice Huang was said to be a top executive for the firm at the time. Omniverse brings together real-to-sim tools and agent skills to help developers turn real-world captures into editable starting environments for physical AI simulation. David Wehr, from NVIDIA’s simulation technology team, built on that work using Astra to develop a workflow for digitally reconstructing a building without its contents. items.fullText: Kazakhstan Expands Compute for Its AI Future Jensen Huang’s visit to the nation’s capital, Astana — including a presidential meeting and public fireside chat — coincided with new AI infrastructure commitments anchored by NVIDIA compute. October 22, 2026 by Rev Lebaredian 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Kazakhstan’s AI ecosystem is moving from infrastructure plans to deployment. The shift is visible across the full AI stack — from infrastructure to models to applications. The announcements below — coinciding with a visit to Astana by NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang — point to the nation’s increasing supply of accelerated computing, along with its growing demand for what comes next. On Friday, Oct. 23, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang visited Astana, meeting with President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev at the Akorda Presidential Palace and joining Deputy Prime Minister Zhaslan Madiyev — Kazakhstan’s minister of AI and digital development — for a public fireside chat at the Alem.AI program. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Jensen Huang and Kazakhstan’s AI Minister Speak at Alem.AI In their fireside chat at Alem.AI, Kazakhstan’s international center for artificial intelligence, Madiyev and Huang discussed the country’s push to become an AI nation — building the energy and computing infrastructure to support homegrown AI and applying it across the economy. Madiyev said Kazakhstan wants AI that reflects its language and culture. “We want AI that understands and speaks Kazakh and captures cultural contexts and cultural specifics,” he said, describing the country’s work on Kazakh-language models. Huang said Kazakhstan could turn its energy resources into a foundation for AI production — and a new kind of export. “Instead of just exporting energy, in the future, you could transform energy into intelligence and export intelligence,” he said. October 22, 2026 by Brian Sparks 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Launched today, NVIDIA Minerva is an AIOps platform built to help teams find problems earlier and keep AI factories productive. It brings together telemetry from infrastructure and AI workloads, then applies purpose-built AI models to turn that data into timely, actionable insight. AI factories are among the most complex operations in the world, with vast numbers of GPUs working across high-speed networks to train models and serve AI applications. At that scale, a single degraded component can slow an entire job. The warning signs may be easy to miss, such as a GPU running hotter than its peers or an NVMe drive losing performance under load. The platform focuses on AI factory yield, a measure of the useful work infrastructure produces through GPU hours, goodput, cluster uptime and token production. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Delivering a Dynamic View of an AI Factory Traditional monitoring tools often divide the data center into separate views. Networking, compute, site reliability and machine learning teams each see a different part of the operation. Minerva connects those signals across NVIDIA GPUs, networking, storage, schedulers and workloads. With these signals, Minerva builds a dynamic knowledge graph that logically maps the infrastructure — GPUs, SuperNICs, switches and cables — and the jobs running on it. This context helps operators trace a slow training job to the component affecting it, even across a factory with hundreds of thousands of GPUs. At GTC Berlin, banks, payment companies and financial data providers are showing what production-scale intelligence looks like — built on NVIDIA accelerated computing, powered by open weight models and running on their own infrastructure. Revolut is rebuilding its technology stack on a single foundation model PRAGMA , powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing. Using the NVIDIA cuDF toolkit and Dynamo-Triton software on NVIDIA Blackwell Ultra GPUs , Revolut is scaling PRAGMA in production, servicing an initial 80 million customers and engineered to scale 3x. “Revolut processes billions of transactions — the opportunity was always there, but the question was whether foundation models could operate at that scale and across domains. items.fullText: How Companies Are Using NVIDIA DSX to Break the Power Bottleneck Companies around the world are using the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform to plan, simulate and run AI factories as one system and unlock infrastructure development. October 21, 2026 by Vladimir Troy 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Companies around the world are building on the NVIDIA DSX AI Factory Platform to plan, simulate and run the grid and the AI factory as one system, from the substation to the rack. Their adoption of the platform responds to an acute problem. Power is now the biggest bottleneck in infrastructure. More than $300 billion in equipment is backlogged, and over 200 gigawatts of projects are waiting in U.S. interconnection queues. One root cause of the bottleneck is siloed systems. The grid, the facility and the compute inside have long been designed independently from one another, creating the conditions for delays, risk and stranded capacity. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements To help address this, NVIDIA DSX brings these systems together: NVIDIA DSX Sim and SimReady assets from leading energy manufacturers let engineers simulate the grid, substation and AI factory together, validating generators, switchgear, power systems and cooling before breaking ground. NVIDIA DSX Flex syncs AI factory demand with grid conditions and onsite generation, turning AI factories from static loads into flexible grid assets. NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS and DSX Exchange squeeze more compute from every watt and securely share signals across compute, networking, energy, cooling and operations. GE Vernova is deploying its grid-to-facility and rack power expertise to complement NVIDIA DSX systems, enabling customers to transform power constraints into competitive advantages while maximizing compute and token output, sustainability and grid reliability. items.fullText: Pioneers Across Europe Deploy NVIDIA Earth-2 Open Models to Power Real-World Weather and Climate Prediction October 21, 2026 by Niall Robinson 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Weather forecasts shape more than daily plans; timely weather information is crucial for energy producers, insurers and transport operators to plan around changing conditions. A global forecast can show a storm taking shape, but decisions about solar farms, shipping routes or insured property depend on what happens locally. NVIDIA Earth-2 gives developers and researchers a family of open AI models and tools they can customize with their own data. Running on NVIDIA computing, these technologies support global weather prediction, detailed regional forecasts and environmental research. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements StormScope EU is the latest model to join Earth-2 — a regional version of the StormScope model for short-term forecasting, trained over Europe weather and climate data. It uses EUMETSAT satellite observations to predict evolving cloud conditions across 16 Meteosat channels at 10-minute intervals. At GTC Berlin, NVIDIA is showcasing a live StormScope EU pipeline in an interactive weather demo built in partnership with Earthmover . The demo uses Earth2Studio to run forecasts and Earthmover’s data platform to manage and serve the real-time results, which are updated as soon as new satellite observations come in, every 10 minutes. Earthmover serves these results as map tiles, letting visitors explore predictions across Europe without downloading entire datasets. Developers can combine Earth-2 models in workflows tailored to regional needs, using StormScope for short-term forecasting and CorrDiff to add local detail to coarser weather data. Governments need modern solutions to serve the public while keeping sensitive information under their control. Open models provide a path forward, letting governments evaluate them, adapt them to local languages and public services, run them on infrastructure they control, apply their own safeguards and keep sensitive data within controlled environments. Some open models go further, with the datasets they were trained on published so governments can verify if training data was licensed, biased or compliant. NVIDIA partners and European governments are teaming to bring advanced models to boost the efficiency of public administration while retaining control of data and infrastructure. Several are also building editions of the NVIDIA Nemotron-Personas collection , the partner-grounded datasets behind NeMo User Sim , NVIDIA’s open source library for population-scale user simulation that dynamically evaluates and trains models and agents in local languages. items.fullText: Europe’s Industrial Leaders Reinvent Engineering and Manufacturing With NVIDIA October 21, 2026 by James McKenna 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! To increase productivity, accelerate innovation and create new opportunities for economic growth, Europe’s industrial leaders are tapping NVIDIA CUDA-X and Omniverse libraries , as well as NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron open models, across the engineering and manufacturing lifecycle. Bringing those capabilities together on the factory floor, the NVIDIA Factory Operations Blueprint (FOX) is now available in early access on GitHub , providing a path for developers to build and deploy always-on factory manager agents that coordinate work across machines, and specialist agents focused on use cases such as visual inspection, root cause analysis, report generation and fleet management. These agents can connect to frontier models, including NVIDIA Cosmos and Nemotron, and foundational knowledge including computer-aided design, product lifecycle management, simulation software, and IT and operational technology systems. Building on the FOX blueprint enables the ecosystem to build industrial agents that monitor factory operations in real time, correlate visual findings and machine logs to investigate problems, and coordinate responses. With Cosmos in-context learning, these agents can adapt using examples and documentation, without fine-tuning. Siemens is integrating agents built using FOX into Intelligence Center X, its agentic enterprise system, to help identify root causes and coordinate factory operations, for estimated cost savings of 20%. Siemens’ Process Preparation X agents use NVIDIA Cosmos Data Factory tools and skills to generate defect images for circuit-board inspection. At its Erlangen electronics factory, Siemens used this approach to reduce calibration time of inspection processes by 40%. items.fullText: NVIDIA cuDSS Now Generally Available to Accelerate Engineering and Scientific Simulations October 21, 2026 by Timothy Costa 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA cuDSS, launched today in general availability, is an NVIDIA CUDA-X library that shifts a critical part of engineering and scientific simulations onto GPUs. Complex engineering feats — from advanced chips to aircraft to industrial systems —– depend on simulation to predict how designs will perform before they’re built. As designs become more complex, simulations take longer to run, increasing computing demands and limiting the number of ideas teams can test. NVIDIA cuDSS accelerates solving large sparse systems — the math-heavy step that repeats throughout engineering and scientific simulations and often limits how many designs a team can test — by tapping into GPUs. This lets applications reduce time to results and increase simulation throughput, enabling end users to explore larger more realistic models, more accurate representations and a wider design space at a reduced cost. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements Industry leaders are already integrating NVIDIA cuDSS into their tools to transform workflows for their end customers: Applied Materials: With cuDSS, Applied Materials accelerated sparse solves in Ginestra, its physics-based, defect-centric simulation platform, by up to 10x versus CPU-only approaches, speeding exploration of semiconductor materials and device reliability. COMSOL: Using COMSOL Multiphysics with NVIDIA cuDSS on NVIDIA accelerated computing, ZEISS SMT achieved a measured 4x speedup in an EUV lithography plasma simulation benchmark, completing the full simulation in six days and 14 hours. Cadence : Uses cuDSS in its Celsius software to accelerate simulations of heat, structural stress and warpage in advanced chips and 3D chip designs, helping customers including Nokia analyze complex designs faster.
